comments.body:
Not a student and never been to these elite unis. But honestly, if you don't find friends with a B2 in French, what do you want in Zurich if you can't speak any German? I grew up in the french speaking part and live now in the German speaking part and speaking the local language is essential. You might find more expat groups if you go to Zurich but you can also find a lot of people who will be willing to speak with you just going further down the lake to Geneva... 

It might also have to do with seasonal depression like wait until the springtime and people will also be more chill... Plus, if it's your first year, from my experiences in vocational schools, people are also stressed out because it's the time in which the schools take fat off the mammoth... In 2nd year, it's way easier since you also get used to the rhythm and what not.
comments.author: Coco_JuTo
